'''XDL-67''' was [[Ramsey Lanclo]]'s highly-modified [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Originally a [[Cooking droid/Legends|cook-droid]], its mixer arm was replaced by a functional hand, and its programming was enhanced for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] maintenance and repair.
